name: Kodachrome
garments: not a fashion look — a photographic film stock
reacts_against: nothing — it's a specific film stock, prized for rich, warm, highly saturated color and archival stability, discontinued in 2009 as digital photography took over.
revivals: imitated by countless digital photo-editing presets and Instagram-era filters

findings: mostly muted — about 71% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Wikimedia Commons images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
